resources.string: This device could not be reached. On it, open 8K PRO → More → Local sync and turn Sync mode on. Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Colour of the 8K PRO icon and logo
You chose a new icon and logo. They take effect after 8K PRO restarts.
What 8K PRO shows when it starts: Home, the channel you watched last, your favourites, or a channel you pick.
Looks on GitHub for a newer 8K PRO now and offers to install it. Your playlists, favourites and settings stay as they are.
Stage draws 8K PRO’s own soft colours. Picture shows a picture of yours behind every screen. Plain is a flat dark fill.
The 8K PRO logo in the menu, About and setup shows its play triangle in your accent colour. The icon on the home screen keeps its own colours.
This address is for the 8K PRO app on your other device. Open Local sync there and pick this device from the list.
